items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: Merrill Lynch, Pierce Fenner, Ungolight and Smith and all that business, which is now your Merrill Lynch, you know, the big deal.

ctx.x: How did you get interested in bass by the way?

Well I always did like bass. I always did like string bass, Dick. And around 1937 after playing the guitar for four years in the band I decided, well you know the bass player with the Al Streaming Band who was the vice president of the Soil Company and had to do all that road traveling. He was told Streaming and he said, Al I'm going to have to quit the band. He said, I got too much traveling. He had been with the band ten years. So he left the band and that's when Al told me, he said, Bob why don't you switch…
But why does Treeman want you on bass? Do you know?
